name: Boulderfist Outpost
summary: Boulderfist Outpost is a fortified mound nestled deep within the ogre settlement of Boulder'gor in the Arathi Highlands. Serving as an interior den and holding area, it houses aggressive Boulderfist ogres alongside a few Witherbark trolls.

sections.title: A Stronghold within the Mound
sections.body: Carved into the earth and stone of western Arathi, Boulderfist Outpost functions as the heart of Boulder'gor. While brute enforcers dominate the settlement above, the outpost's interior concentrates the clan's core strength and provides a dark subterranean shelter. A handful of Witherbark troll witch doctors occasionally mingle among the ogres here, hinting at tenuous tribal cooperation.

faq.answer: Boulderfist Outpost is an interior mound found within the larger ogre settlement of Boulder'gor, situated in the western expanses of the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why are there trolls inside an ogre outpost?
faq.answer: Witherbark forest trolls dwell nearby in the Arathi Highlands and occasionally share ground with the Boulderfist ogres. A few Witherbark witch doctors can be found practicing their craft within the depths of the outpost alongside the ogres.

faq.q: Who is imprisoned in the outpost?
faq.answer: No named captives are known to be held in the outpost today. Its damp corridors belong to Boulderfist enforcers and a few Witherbark witch doctors, and anyone wandering inside should expect a fight rather than a rescue.

faq.q: Who leads the ogres inside the outpost?
faq.answer: While the clan's brute enforcers patrol the interior, an exceptionally fierce ogre named Kovork is known to lurk within the mound as a notable threat.

angles.text: Alliance scouts traveling Arathi should give the mound a wide berth, as the Boulderfist enforcers inside attack any intruder on sight.
The Boulderfist ogres make no distinction between factions, attacking Horde wanderers just as readily as their Alliance rivals.
